name: WHU-RS19 canonical scene classes
description: Closed-set label vocabulary used by GeoRS-Agent. The 19 classes are inherited unchanged from WHU-RS19; WHU-RS19 ABZSL adds image-level attributes but does not alter the class set. 'canonical' is the exact label string expected in agent outputs; 'display_name' follows the WHU-RS19 ABZSL release.
sources: Xia, G.S. et al. (2010). Structural High-Resolution Satellite Image Indexing. ISPRS TC VII Symposium.
Balestra, M., Paolanti, M., Pierdicca, R. (2025). WHU-RS19 ABZSL. Remote Sensing 17(14), 2384. doi:10.3390/rs17142384
label_normalization: Labels are compared after trimming, Unicode case-folding and collapsing internal whitespace. No synonym replacement is applied.
